proof_steps: Actual profile activity plus original rectangle window gives X0 <= 2*R(cj).
Same longPositions membership gives R(cj)^(1/3+zeta/4) < each supplied long lower endpoint.
zeta > 0 follows from kappa > 0 and kappa <= zeta/10000; hence exponent 1/3 is no larger than 1/3+zeta/4.
The fixed exponent gap 1/3-1/4=1/12 absorbs 2^(1/3) before quantifying R and either endpoint.
N^(1-kap0)/64 < X0 and kap0 < 1 transport that real threshold to one physical N threshold.
